title: Typed-tool lockdown — CONTRACT (no server code)

tag.name: phase6a-contract
tag.note: Tag is created only after the fresh-verifier exit gate passes. Do not apply before verification.

gate.name: phase6a-contract

checks.name: matrix complete
checks.exit_test: 6A-2: row count equals script grant count; every row has role, grant, purpose, and non-blank disposition (TOOL:<name> | DELETE | KEEP-READ)

checks.name: registry valid
checks.exit_test: 6A-3: registry.json validates against registry.schema.json; every TOOL:x in matrix.csv exists; every checks.json check has a tool path for each runner role; every class_tag exists in severity.json

checks.name: every F-id has a control
checks.exit_test: 6A-5: every F-id (F-01..F-70, F-71..F-77) and every registry tool appears at least once in controls.json; controls.json validates against controls.schema.json; each control carries an expected REJECT code

checks.name: policy lint green
checks.exit_test: 6A-4: policy lint passes; recomputed policy_digest written to phase6/out/6A-4/digest.txt (un-sealed)

checks.name: no file outside owned paths changed
checks.exit_test: diff check: no file outside the union of 6A-1..6A-5 owned paths changed (agent files and server code untouched in 6A)

gate.on_pass: git tag phase6a-contract; update STATE.json to verified; tell human to run 6B
gate.on_fail: add decision note to affected WP file and respawn a fresh worker; STATE.json remains PENDING_VERIFICATION

work_packages.title: Findings ingest
work_packages.exit_test: Every row has file:line; per-role counts over F-01..F-70 equal auditor 9, builder 8, orchestrator 9, hacker 8, compliance 7, crouton 6, release-engineer 7, factory-map 8, K1 8; F-71..F-77 present; each row judged CONFIRMED or NOT-REPRODUCIBLE from permission lines alone
work_packages.summary: Findings F-01..F-70 parsed from report.md plus F-71..F-77 seed; 77 rows

work_packages.title: Grant inventory
work_packages.exit_test: Row count equals script grant count (234 data rows + header = 235 lines); no blank disposition; every row has role, grant, purpose, disposition = TOOL:<name> | DELETE | KEEP-READ
work_packages.summary: Grant inventory for the 9 agent files: shell, edit, write, external_directory, question, subagent, skill grants

work_packages.title: Registry
work_packages.exit_test: registry.json validates against registry.schema.json; every TOOL:x in matrix.csv exists as a registry tool (30 tools incl. check.run dispatcher); every checks.json check has a tool path for each of its runner roles; every class_tag exists in severity.json; per-tool roles, args JSON-schema, exec_mode (pure|sandbox|k1), sealed + cache key, >=3 controls, redact:true
work_packages.summary: 30 typed tools seeded from the required tool surface table; checks collapsed into check.run generated from checks.json runners

work_packages.title: Policy reconciliation
work_packages.exit_test: Policy lint passes (phase6/out/6A-4/lint.py); F-71..F-75 fixed (ci-required.json single source, missing severity classes added, exact-match covered_by, assert-rules extended to message/comment tails + unittest + TS/JS, redaction allowlist + narrower phone/ipv4); probe-record schema added; recomputed policy_digest written to phase6/out/6A-4/digest.txt (un-sealed); fixtures in phase6/out/6A-4/fixtures/
work_packages.summary: Policy fixes F-71..F-75 plus probe-record schema; digest un-sealed; agent-file prose left for 6C-1c
notes: release-engineer.md prose check list drift deferred to 6C-1c (agent files outside files/policies/**)
Redaction runner patch deferred to 6B-0; 6A-4 ships policy-side allowlist only
No git tag/branch applied: no .git checkout at harness root

work_packages.title: Controls
work_packages.exit_test: controls.json validates against controls.schema.json; every F-id (F-01..F-70, F-71..F-77) and every registry tool (30) appears at least once; each control carries an expected REJECT code (167 controls)
work_packages.summary: 167 known-bad calls: one per F-id and per registry tool, each with expected REJECT code

order: 6A-1 and 6A-2 parallel; then 6A-3 and 6A-4 parallel; then 6A-5
handoff: Independent verifier: run all 6A exit tests + gate checks GATE-1..GATE-5 from STATE.json alone. On pass, tag phase6a-contract and tell human to run 6B. On fail, add a decision note to the affected WP file and respawn a fresh worker; never mark DONE without a fresh verifier pass.
